Frameworks

Our Approach and Frameworks

What was said is only the beginning.

People do not always act on messages as they were intended. They act on what those messages mean to them. We look beyond message delivery to the human process of interpretation, understanding, trust and action.

Human Communication Intelligence

Human Communication Intelligence

At Goldapples, Human Communication Intelligence is the capacity to understand how people create, convey, interpret and act upon meaning.

We apply that understanding to promote more conscious, responsible and effective communication that strengthens relationships, leadership and organisational performance.

Four questions matter:

01

What did we intend?

02

What did people understand?

03

Where did meaning change?

04

What happened next?

Principles

From Awareness to Better Outcomes

Communication consciousness:Notice how communication works and affects others.

Communication responsibility:Choose how to communicate with integrity and regard for consequences.

Communication effectiveness:Enable clearer understanding and purposeful responses, including where people disagree.

These are principles guiding our practice, not claims that communication alone resolves every conflict or performance problem.

Tools & Frameworks

Tools That Put Thinking to Work

The M.E.A.N.I.N.G. Framework

A practical way to examine how a message moves from intention through interpretation towards understanding and action.

Practical Evaluation

How Do We Know Communication Is Working?

The useful questions are practical:

01

Are priorities better understood?

02

Are key audiences clearer about the decision?

03

Are questions being heard?

04

Is the intended action happening?

The measures depend on the challenge. We do not mistake activity or agreement for understanding.

One Principle We Hold Close

Mutual understanding does not mean mutual agreement.

Good communication makes differences clearer and decisions more deliberate. It does not require everyone to think alike.
